webglInfo.note: Capability evidence of intentionally induced WebGL context loss via WEBGL_lose_context extension in headless Chrome; not a spontaneous Cesium runtime failure or application recovery proof.

mediaDevices.note: Evaluated in supported disposable secure context (http://127.0.0.1:57751). Prior MEDIA_DEVICES_NOT_SUPPORTED in 46a952a resulted from about:blank insecure origin in headless Chrome, not absent physical hardware. Hardware devices enumerated: audioinput, videoinput, audiooutput. Note that per W3C specification, device labels remain empty until explicit user permission is granted.
